headline: You own the date and the people risk.
trigger: Program funded, Systems Integrator (SI) selected, go-live date set 6–12 months out.
pains: The Systems Integrator (SI) plan covers cutover; people readiness is a line item for training sessions
Status reports are green, but you can’t see whether operations is ready
Internal HR and L&D don’t have capacity for a program this size
SMEs in design sessions rebuild today’s workarounds in the new system
message: Your Systems Integrator (SI) will get the system live. Who’s making sure your people can run the operation on day one?
